newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Denktash says Cyprus talks over without EU reversal.
newsitem.headline: Denktash says Cyprus talks over without EU reversal.

text.p: Turkish Cypriot leader Rauf Denktash insisted on Thursday he would pull out of talks to reunite the island unless the European Union reversed a decision to start entry talks for the Greek Cypriot government.

"The European Union is the stumbling block. If the European Union keeps its word and treats the Greek Cypriot side as Cyprus then what is the use of talking? This is the last round until the EU decides," he told reporters after a fourth day of talks with Greek Cypriot leader Glafcos Clerides and U.N. mediator Diego Cordovez.

Denktash told reporters in Montreux along Lake Geneva: "We will have to wait to see whether the EU will regard us as an existing factor for Cyprus or continue to disregard us. It is a very big tragedy the EU has committed while the talks were going on in a good atmosphere. It is a Greek tragedy."
But Denktash said he would stay at the negotiation table until the end of the talks, scheduled for Friday.
The United Nations, in an effort to find a constructive way forward, has been trying to get the Greek and Turkish Cypriots to agree to a joint statement before the round ends.

But Denktash said: "I say that if the EU treats the Greek Cypriots as its interlocator I will not talk. Mr Clerides now says that if the EU delays, he will not talk. The EU has succeeded in creating the best impasse ever in the Cyprus problem. They can be proud about it."
